difficulty_reason: Trace_{B/A} is the trace element for finite flat maps: traces commute with base change, and under the product decomposition omega_{B_1/A_1} = omega_{C/A_1} x omega_{D/A_1} the trace splits factorwise, so the defining property holds after the etale-split reduction. Retained author proof at lines 879-891.
